senses.gloss:
लज् 1. लज् (= rt. लज्ज्, q. v.), cl. 6. A.
लजते, लेजे, लजितुम्, to be ashamed:
Caus. लाजयति: Desid. लिलजिषते: Intens. लालज्-
यते, लालक्ति.

लज् 2. लज् (= rt. 1. लञ्ज्), cl. 1. P. ल-
जति, &c., to fry, roast; to calumniate,
blame.

लज्ज् लज्ज् (perhaps connected with a
base रज्य fr. rt. रञ्ज्; cf. rt. 1. लज्),
cl. 6. A. लज्जते (sometimes also P. लज्जति), ललज्जे,
लज्जिष्यते, अलज्जिष्ट, लज्जितुम्, to be ashamed,
blush: Caus. लज्जयति: Desid. लिलज्जिषते: Intens.
लालज्ज्यते.

लाज् लाज् or लाञ्ज् [cf. rt. 2. लज्], cl. 1. P.
लाजति (in Nirukta VI. 9. लाजते), लाञ्-
जति, &c., to fry, roast, parch; to blame, censure.

लज-कारिका, f. (लज for लज्जा), the sensitive
plant, Mimosa Pudica.

लज्ज, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his
descendants.

लज्जा, f. shame, modesty, bashfulness; Shame
[]
(personified as the wife of Dharma and as the
mother of Vinaya); the sensitive plant, Mimosa
Pudica.
—लज्जा-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, or लज्जा-
कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing or occasioning shame,
shameful.
—लज्जाकृति (˚जा-आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, feigning
modesty.
—लज्जान्वित (˚जा-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessed of shame, ashamed, modest, bashful.
—लज्जा-
रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, void of shame, shameless, im-
modest.
—लज्जा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of shame,
full of shame, ashamed, bashful, modest; embar-
rassed, perplexed.
—लज्जावत्-त्व, अम्, n. bashful-
ness, modesty.
—लज्जा-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of a modest
disposition, bashful, modest.
—लज्जा-शून्य or लज्जा-
हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of shame, void of modesty,
shameless, impudent.

लाज, अस्, m. (supposed by some to be connected
with rt. 1. भ्रज्ज् or भृज्), fried or parched grain;
wetted or sprinkled grain; (आस्), m. pl. parched or
roasted grain, (also आ, f.); (अम्), n. the root of
Andropogon Muricatus.
लज्जका, f. the wild cotton-tree, Gossypium.

लज्जत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, being ashamed,
blushing.
लज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, blushing, feeling shame.
लज्जरी, f. a white sensitive plant.

लज्जाय, Nom. (probably A.) लज्जायते, &c., to
be ashamed.

लज्जायित, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed, embar-
rassed.

लज्जालु, उस्, उस्, उ, bashful, modest, shameful;
(उस्), m. f. the sensitive plant, Mimosa Pudica.

लज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, ashamed, abashed, modest,
bashful.

लज्जिरी, f. = लज्जालु, Mimosa Pudica; [cf. लज्-
जरी.]
लज्या, f. = लज्जा, shame, modesty.

लाजि, इस्, m., Ved. a quantity of parched grain,
(according to a commentator on Taittirīya-Brāhmaṇa
III. 9, 4, 8, लाजि is voc. c. fr. लाजिन् = लाजोपल-
क्षित.)
लाजी, f., N. of a place.
